notes.title: First Update! (Just Optimization Fixes)
notes.content:
Hey all, after receiving some feedback, I have implemented a couple changes to the game!

1. Cursor has been removed and set to the default windows cursor to help hitboxes be more accurate and solves the dual monitor problem.

2. Hitboxes of keys have been greatly increased.

3. Calvin the Clown is more likely to blow his whistle to ensure you don't run out of time on a level just waiting for him to play a note.

4. New taskbar icons while playing the game :)

Thanks for supporting my first game\, I hope this update makes the game more enjoyable and accessible!

P.S. MOBILE VERSION COMING SOON TO THE APP STORE!

notes.title: MR. WALKER'S BASEMENT IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
August of 2020, I had no game developing experience. All I knew is that I wanted to make my own video game. Fast-forward a couple months later and my first game as a solo indie developer is out! Can't wait for you all to play MR. WALKER'S BASEMENT! Follow me on instagram @digitalbathtub for news and updates for more games!
